column1: comment
The new park renovation has completely transformed our neighborhood. Families are using it every day.
Traffic on Main Street has gotten worse since the construction started. There is no clear end date.
The public library extended hours are a welcome change for working parents.
Waste collection has been inconsistent this month. Two missed pickups on our street alone.
The community garden initiative brought neighbors together in a way nothing else has.
Streetlights on Elm Avenue have been broken for weeks. It is a safety concern at night.
The local council meetings are now streamed online. Much more accessible for residents who work late.
Bus frequency on Route 12 was cut with no prior notice. Commuters are struggling.
The new bike lanes are well-designed and I feel safe using them daily.
Noise from the construction site starts at 6am on weekends. That is not acceptable.
The free summer program for children was very well organized and our kids loved it.
Potholes on the north side have not been repaired despite multiple complaints submitted.
The new recycling guidelines are clearer now. Participation in our building went up noticeably.
Flooding on River Road during rain is a recurring problem that has not been addressed in years.
Community events at the civic center have been excellent this season. Good variety of programming.
The permitting office response times are too slow. We waited 6 weeks for a simple approval.
The senior shuttle service has been a lifeline for elderly residents in our community.
The park restrooms are consistently dirty and understaffed for maintenance.
Overall the neighborhood has improved in the last year. Feels cleaner and safer.
Communication from the city about upcoming changes needs to be much more proactive.
The new dog park is a great addition. Well-fenced and maintained.
Youth sports programs were cancelled mid-season with no explanation provided to families.
The digital permit portal saved us significant time compared to the old paper process.
Night markets have been a success and brought real foot traffic to local businesses.
Snow removal response this winter was faster than previous years. Appreciated the improvement.
